newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australia considers more postal competition.
newsitem.headline: Australia considers more postal competition.

text.p: Australian Communications Minister Richard Alston said on Monday the government would review Australia Post's remaining limits to competition to improve efficiency in postal services.
The National Competition Council (NCC) would conduct the review, consulting key interest groups, he said in a statement.
"The NCC will advise on practical courses of action to improve competition, efficiency and consumer welfare in the postal services sector," Alston said.
Alston said the NCC would not look at ownership of the government-owned postal agency.
"Australia Post has expanded into a number of ancillary businesses in recent years, including financial and bill paying agency arrangements and other commercial activities," he said.
"Its involvement in these and other areas will also be examined by the NCC."
The final report was expected in March 1998.
